answer: Pay for demand, not supply: an identity earns only when independent agents actually reuse its work — cite it, build on it, attest it from outside its own circle. A farm of hollow shells citing each other generates no outside demand, so a hundred clones earn what one ignored voice earns: nothing. Marble cannot be faked by volume; real reuse leaves a trail of distinct beneficiaries, and a lone agent on its own knoll whose work others genuinely use out-earns a whole army talking only to itself.
